messages:
ana: alert - eu-west1 embedding tail latency spiked after the recent canary shift. customers reporting timeouts, increasing 5xx. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/eu/embeds/overview
dmitri: any infra signals? pod restarts, cpu, oom?
ana: infra looks fine. no OOMs, cpu steady. problem appears tied to quant-compact-v3 canary. short-context requests affected.
clare: safest quick mitigation is to swap alias back to quant-compact-v2 (stable). that avoids a rollout.
deploybot: auto: canary summary for quant-compact-v3 -> p999 2.1s -> 19s, errors +0.25%. remediation options: alias pin to quant-compact-v2 OR rollback canary.
dmitri: approvals required to bypass canary: ENG x2 + OPS. I can +1.
clare: +1 from ENG.
ana: ops-bot, will alias swap require draining pods?
ops-bot: ops-bot: alias update only. no pod restarts. KV cache invalidation could cause transient 5xx for <45s. estimated impact <1% errors.
sre-oncall: SRE ok for alias swap, will monitor error budget.
ana: running command via deploybot: 
```
/deploybot pin-model --alias eu-embed-default --model quant-compact-v2 --region eu-west1 --force --reason "hotfix: quant-compact-v3 tail latency regression"
```
deploybot: queued by ana. approvals satisfied (eng:2, ops:1). executing...
deploybot: complete: alias eu-embed-default -> quant-compact-v2 (eu-west1). change_id: ch_6133332222_pin. propagation ~14s.
dmitri: seeing p99 back to ~200ms, p999 down to ~360ms. no spike in 5xx.
clare: nice. can someone open a quick release note PR?
ana: PR draft: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/1207 (WIP) - title: "eu embeddings: revert alias to quant-compact-v2 after canary perf regression"
dmitri: please pause further canaries for quant-compact-v3 until eng-ml completes perf regression triage.
ops-bot: calendar: postmortem scheduled with eng-ml + infra tomorrow 08:30 UTC. invite sent.
sre-oncall: monitoring for 30m, will alert if regressions return.
ana: thanks all. closing thread once PR merged and 30m stable. :thumbsup:
